window.label: fresh v1.5 1X-only replay over completed matches in the requested 30-day lookback window

replayRules.chronology: Each fixture used only earlier completed matches from the same season/league.
replayRules.minimumHistory: At least 3 earlier matches per team, at least 1 earlier home match for the home team, and at least 1 earlier away match for the away team.
replayRules.lambda: 35% home team's recent GF + 35% away team's recent GA + 15% home venue GF + 15% away venue GA for lambda_H; mirrored calculation for lambda_A, clamped 0.20–3.50.
replayRules.probability: 70% Poisson 1X probability + 15% recent empirical 1X support + 15% venue empirical 1X support.
replayRules.footballGate: 1X probability >=65%; recent-form support >=60%; home/away support >=60%; goals profile lambda_H >= 0.9*lambda_A; Poisson 1X >=65%; both empirical support checks positive; Heat >=2.
replayRules.settlement: 1X wins when home team wins or draws.

limitations: This is a fresh v1.5 1X-only replay and does not use older-version predictions.
Historical same-bookmaker price snapshots were not available in this dataset, so the +4pp no-vig edge and +5% EV gates were not applied.
Therefore 80.0% is the football-gate hit rate, not yet the fully price-verified Core hit rate.
Only the eight leagues available in a consistent 2026/27 machine-readable format were included.
The confidence interval is wide because there were only 35 qualified 1X selections.
